title: BNCI 2014-001 Motor Imagery dataset
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 9 healthy participants performing cued motor imagery of the left hand, right hand, feet, and tongue. It corresponds to BCI Competition IV Dataset 2a, a widely used benchmark for 4-class motor imagery classification. Each participant completed two sessions of six runs, with 22 EEG and 3 EOG channels sampled at 250 Hz. The recordings are provided in a BIDS-formatted derivative with HED event annotations.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainAmp MR plus amplifier and Ag/AgCl electrodes (EASYCAP cap) at 250 Hz, with 22 EEG and 3 EOG channels referenced to the left mastoid and bandpass filtered at 0.05-200 Hz. Each session had 6 runs. Participants performed 4-second cued motor imagery of the left hand, right hand, feet, or tongue, prompted by arrow cues. Each subject had a training session (2 runs, 200 trials) and a test session (4 runs, 240 trials).
